title: Score32 exact ordered finalizer-bank control PPA scaling
hypothesis: The flat c16+b59 wrapper couples tree, dispatch, ordering, and arithmetic into a single resource-heavy netlist. Extracting the ordered bank-dispatch control as a standalone concrete RTL block should reveal the true control-only area and timing scaling across representative bank counts, while explicitly excluding the wide payload fanout and root payload mux so later hierarchical composition can combine this control anchor with measured lane-8 finalizer macro PPA and the checked-in exact service model.

direct_comparison.primary_question: What Nangate45 area and timing boundary is exposed by standalone exact ordered finalizer-bank control at b1, b4, b8, b16, b32, and b59 for lane-8 service under a bounded one-density first pass?
include: strict config, manifest, regeneration, compact transaction-tag control-only probe/equivalence, and PPA-sweep guard before synthesis
hierarchical OpenROAD block sweeps at one bounded place density
timing-summary extraction for each checked-in bank-control configuration
exclude: no exact finalizer arithmetic in this block
no partial-tree logic in this block
no wide 328-bit payload fanout to banks in this block
no wide 320-bit root payload mux in this block
no claim that the standalone control closes the full decoder attention path

remaining_abstractions: This item measures only dispatch, outstanding, ordering FIFO, compact transaction-tag retirement selection, and bank-side control interfaces; exact finalizer arithmetic remains a separate measured macro.
The wide payload fanout into banks and the wide root payload mux are deferred to measured hierarchical composition rather than included in this control-only anchor.
The upstream partial tree is excluded, so later composed conclusions must add measured tree cost rather than treat this as a whole finalized-root macro.
No NoC or SRAM placement closure claim is made here.
